title: Render the Harness app icon
responsibility: Creates a square PNG of the shared gold Harness mark on navy for iOS or Mac.

inputs.name: brandIcon.size
inputs.description: The requested width and height in pixels. Callers should supply a usable whole-number image size; this helper does not validate a supported size range.

inputs.name: brandIcon.variant
inputs.description: The icon treatment: ios by default for an opaque navy background, or mac for a rounded navy plate inside a transparent margin.

outputs.name: brandIcon
outputs.description: PNG bytes at the requested square size, using RGB for iOS and RGBA transparency for Mac. Geometry comes from the shared brand tiles; no file is written.
